title: chore(deps): narrow the React peer range to ^19.0.0 (objectui#13465)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D7MWhuS4kuhvDQHJjWfeGnM)_

Fixes #13465

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- **改了什么:** 所有向宿主要 React 的 objectui 包,把 `react` / `react-dom` 的 peer 依赖从 `^18.0.0 || ^19.0.0` 收窄到 `^19.0.0`(实测 31 个包、56 条声明;卡上写的 33 个是旧计数)。AGENTS.md §2 和技能里的同一句「React 18+」改成「React 19」;脚手架 create-plugin 生成的新插件同样只声明 19。
- **为什么改:** 我们对外承诺能跑在 React 18 上,但仓里从没装过、测过 React 18。按你的裁决 A:只卖我们测过的。
- **风险与代价(含回滚):** 还停留在 React 18 的宿主,装下一版时会收到 peer 依赖警告或被拒装,需要先升级到 React 19。目前没有已知的 React 18 用户(未实测 npm 下游)。每个包一个 minor changeset 并写明 breaking,不动 major。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **席位意见:**
- **你要做的(一个动作):**

## What changed

- **31 manifests, 56 peer declarations** (31 `react` + 25 `react-dom`) now read `^19.0.0`. Derived by any spelling on `cd70b78`: no other React peer spelling and no `@types/react` peer exists in the workspace.
- **Pins that hold the range, moved with it** (each would go red otherwise):
  - `react-peer-range-norm-3741.test.ts`: `REACT_PEER_NORM` is now `^19.0.0`, with a docblock paragraph saying why the 18 arm went.
  - `doc-version-claims.test.ts`: the 12 package README peer lines are asserted verbatim against their manifests, so the READMEs move; ledger keys follow (`PEER_19`, the react-runtime prose line, the two plugin-skeleton samples). The two `React 18+` unanchored entries are deleted: "React 19" carries no version token the scan records, and the ratchet refuses an entry that outlives its claim.
  - `QUICK_REFERENCE.md`: the React row reads `19.x`; `quick-reference-current-release-4143.test.ts` derives it from the peer majors.
- **`AGENTS.md` §2** (governed): "React 18+ (Hooks)" → "React 19 (Hooks)", per the ruling.
- **`skills/**` (published skills face), two files, net line delta 0, rewrite in place:**
  - `skills/objectui/SKILL.md`: the Tech Stack line is the verbatim mirror of AGENTS.md §2 (the doc-version-claims ledger states it is), so it moves with §2 to keep the two agent-facing texts in sync.
  - `skills/objectui/guides/plugin-development.md`: the plugin skeleton's `peerDependencies` now say `^19.0.0`. A plugin built on `@object-ui/*` packages that only accept React 19 cannot honestly offer React 18 to its host; same change as the create-plugin generator below.
- **`@object-ui/create-plugin`**: a generated plugin's peers are `^19.0.0` (user-visible, own minor changeset). The hand-written skeleton in `content/docs/guide/plugins.md` moves the same way.
- **Prose and comments that cited the old range:** `content/docs/guide/troubleshooting.md`, two "Built with React 18+" lines in `packages/components` docs, and comment-only edits in `useGlobalUndo` (`@object-ui/react`), `inline-markdown` (`@object-ui/components`), and `scaffold-dependencies` plus its test (`@object-ui/cli`; no release needed for a comment, the gate is satisfied by the other changesets).
- **32 changesets**, `.changeset/13465-react-peer-*.md`: one `minor` per package with a **Breaking** note (no `major`, per 版本号策略).
- `pnpm-lock.yaml` is unchanged: workspace importers do not record peer ranges, and `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` passed on the narrowed manifests.

## Gates run locally (head `08400c4`)

```
node scripts/sync-quick-reference-release.mjs --check :: exit 0

node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs :: exit 0
pnpm check:new-line-citations :: exit 0
pnpm exec eslint (the 7 changed .ts/.tsx files, listed by git diff --name-only) :: exit 0
```

## Acceptance notes

- Not done, out of scope: no runtime code changes here. Code that exists only to keep React 18 working, if any, was not searched for; it is a possible cleanup, not a defect. `dropped — no defect`.
- The peer narrowing of a published range owes a contract-review-tier review before the queue (claim 6391446264); the skills/** hunk owes the same (seat comment 6391465213).

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
